{{Lang|Crownless|zh=梦魇·无冠者}} is an [[Overlord Class]] [[Nightmare Variant|Nightmare]] [[Boss]] in ''[[Wuthering Waves]]'' that can be found in {{Location|Penitent's End|nocat=1}}. 

Nightmare: Crownless is only unlocked after ''discovering'' all four [[Dream Patrol]] challenges in [[Penitent's End]].
